signals.usability_note: Shows the side of a house behind a wooden fence, seen from across a lawn. It is not a straight-on frontage view, but the house exterior is partly visible.
signals.notes: The photo is taken from a corner lot looking at the side of the house, which has light gray vinyl siding, a weathered wooden privacy fence and a sunroom or porch windows; a silver car is parked at the far left on the neighboring street or property.
